description: Machine-readable bridge contract mapping the historical Qt/QWebChannel frontend bridge to the Electron/Python JSONL sidecar for LecturePack Phase 8. The contract and test oracle are reconciled with the four narrow production-seam operations implemented for the Phase 8 gate.

operations.name: active_job
operations.notes: Names which lecture the workspace belongs to.

operations.name: ai_done
operations.notes: Study AI streaming events are deferred.

operations.name: ai_token
operations.notes: Study AI streaming events are deferred.

operations.name: ask_ai
operations.notes: Study AI is deferred; beyond Phase 8 core.

operations.name: bootstrap_complete
operations.notes: Emitted by the sidecar after engine and packaged-runtime bootstrap completes; the payload closes the existing runtime gate for the production CPU bundle.

operations.name: bootstrap_progress
operations.notes: Emitted by the sidecar while the engine imports.

operations.name: browse_video
operations.notes: Electron main opens a dialog and forwards the selection to import_video.

operations.name: cancel_job
operations.notes: Cancels the active pipeline and reports the terminal status.

operations.name: check_updates
operations.notes: Updater is deferred; not required by Phase 8.

operations.name: delete_job
operations.notes: Job deletion is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: delete_jobs
operations.notes: Bulk job deletion is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: end_demo_job
operations.notes: The guided demo end maps to cancel_job but is out of the Phase 8 core.

operations.name: error
operations.notes: Sent for command failures and stage failures; carries ok:false on command responses.

operations.name: exit
operations.notes: Emitted by the Electron host when the sidecar exits.

operations.name: exit_application
operations.notes: app.js exit_application is not a real backend slot; the renderer closes the window and the host performs clean shutdown via the shutdown command.

operations.name: export
operations.notes: app.js export_all and export_one both map to the export command.

operations.name: export_all
operations.notes: app.js export_all maps to the export sidecar command.

operations.name: export_done
operations.notes: Signals the Study Pack export completed.

operations.name: export_one
operations.notes: app.js export_one maps to the export sidecar command.

operations.name: export_progress
operations.notes: Emitted during the Export stage with the existing UI fields pct and label.

operations.name: get_bootstrap
operations.notes: app.js requests initial state via get_bootstrap; Electron intercepts as a noop and drives bootstrap via ready + host bootstrap.

operations.name: get_job
operations.notes: Restores one persisted job; the Electron host calls get_job + get_slides + get_transcript on reopen.

operations.name: get_slides
operations.notes: Reads detected slide candidates and emits slides_changed.

operations.name: get_transcript
operations.notes: Reads the canonical transcript and emits transcript_changed.

operations.name: health_check
operations.notes: Sidecar verifies the engine and packaged CPU runtime before the Electron host bootstraps the job list.

operations.name: import_video
operations.notes: Creates a persisted job from a local file and activates it.

operations.name: job_completed
operations.notes: Emitted after the final Export stage completes.

operations.name: jobs_changed
operations.notes: Renderer-facing signal is the direct job-summary array expected by app.ui.app.js; electron-bridge.js strips the envelope.

operations.name: list_jobs
operations.notes: Enumerates persisted jobs and emits a jobs_changed summary array.

operations.name: list_ollama_models
operations.notes: Ollama is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: log_line
operations.notes: Streams processing log lines to the renderer.

operations.name: media_link_support
operations.notes: URL/Paste Link capability probe is deferred and intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: onboarding
operations.notes: Carries the newly imported video summary for the home screen.

operations.name: open_export_folder
operations.notes: Handled in the Electron main process via get_job.response.export_dir.

operations.name: open_job
operations.notes: app.js open_job maps to the get_job sidecar command.

operations.name: open_job_folder
operations.notes: Handled in the Electron main process via get_job.response.job_dir.

operations.name: pause_job
operations.notes: Pause is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: pipeline_changed
operations.notes: Carries the per-stage progress array consumed by the pipeline/stages UI.

operations.name: probe_media_url
operations.notes: URL/Paste Link import is deferred, not required by Phase 8.

operations.name: ready
operations.notes: Sent once by the sidecar when the engine and stdin reader are ready.

operations.name: restart_job
operations.notes: Restart maps to start_job but is deferred as a distinct operation for Phase 8.

operations.name: resume_job
operations.notes: Resume maps to start_job but is deferred as a distinct queue operation for Phase 8.

operations.name: save_corrections
operations.notes: Persists the existing transcript working layer and legacy edited.json mirror without changing raw transcript output.

operations.name: set_job_group
operations.notes: Job grouping is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: set_jobs_group
operations.notes: Bulk job grouping is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: set_setting
operations.notes: Primary processing settings applied; secondary acknowledged without persistence; theme handled locally and never sent to the sidecar.

operations.name: set_slide_state
operations.notes: Persists the existing candidates.json accept/reject decision by the renderer slide index and refreshes slides_changed.

operations.name: settings_changed
operations.notes: Emitted after a set_setting call; there is no initial full-settings push (get_settings is a noop).

operations.name: shutdown
operations.notes: Stops the sidecar; the Electron host then terminates the full process tree and emits exit.

operations.name: slides_changed
operations.notes: Carries the slide list and duration for the slides screen.

operations.name: smart_study_status
operations.notes: Ollama/smart study is deferred; intercepted as a noop.

operations.name: start_demo_job
operations.notes: The guided demo maps to start_job but is out of the Phase 8 core; production scope hides the demo entry point.

operations.name: start_processing
operations.notes: app.js start_processing maps to the start_job command with mode, preset, and auto_export.

operations.name: status_changed
operations.notes: Reports the job status label and percent.

operations.name: storage_changed
operations.notes: Storage measurement events are deferred; the sidebar storage widget remains hidden.

operations.name: transcript_changed
operations.notes: Carries the review segments and transcript blocks for the transcript screen.

operations.name: ui_ready
operations.notes: Legacy ui_ready slot is acknowledged (noop); readiness is driven by the sidecar ready event and pageReady.

operations.name: validate_cuda
operations.notes: Backend admission / GPU validation is deferred.

operations.name: validate_vulkan
operations.notes: Backend admission / GPU validation is deferred.
